ios.desc:
"add, forget, remind, remember" 

Thats the sole aim of "wordpoke". It will poke you when the time comes to refresh a word / phrase or sentence.

- Reminders:
Reminders can be based on space based learning or you can set them by the daily, hourly or even none. The reminder system does not need the internet to work!

- Tailor made: 
You enter the items you want.

- Twitter Lookup
See how real speakers of your items use them in everyday sentences.

I proudly use this app everyday.

How I use it?
"bite size learning" whilst on the way to work. I get a notification, I read it, I take it in, im done.

I set hourly reminders, so during the evening I dont forget something I wanted to do.

quotes.text:
The name is "wordpoke".
http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/wordpoke/id471756627

I use the app every day as I built it for me first, the internet second.

A blog post is in draft, waiting the "first update" as its all part of the learning curve I wanted to cover in my journey into iOS development.

A new update to the app will be arriving within 10 days, Apple willing. 
( It was interesting to learn how to tackle upgrades to the database. )

Issues can be reported and progress can be viewed:
https://github.com/freshteapot/wordpoke/issues

New features are not on that list.

The webpage for "wordpoke" is http://wordpoke.me

On the way to work, I realised I should and now will add it to my profile.
quotes.story_title: The best way to learn iOS Programming... well its working for me
